## ajad-p01-v01 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Real and unreal differ nowhere in their own self — the opponent's certainty, stretched to conscious and unconscious. Showing, telling, being: none of it touches own-form, which faces the knower alone. Object-of-showing fits no self, since leaning breaks oneness and oversteps being. The grant costs nothing — appearing's coming and going still serves the end. Being fits only appearing-bound. Function cannot part them either: only existents work, yet working leans on knowers. So all standing is awareness-based. And awareness itself, ungrasping-formed, ranks with non-being and the inert.

*Rasa: adbhuta (wonder) at dialectical reversal — The sthāyibhāva is the shock of the turn (v9): after eight verses of demolition, the proof stings its own ground — bare shining is jaḍa. The vyabhicāri is intellectual triumph (vīra) as each candidate dissolves. Abhinava's camatkāra covers dispute-relish: wonder at reasoning that unseats its own seat.*
